CC: painful callus and new burning sensation in the forefoot

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

MDM: addressed the procedure as well as a separate complaint; considered conservative options for the separate complaint and deferred a decision.

Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
